one_line: Out-of-sample over-suppression acceptance audit of all seven staged/live class-separation detector candidates on three pre-registered adversarial corpora (34 genuine assertions with cue-stripped twins): no candidate passes; newest worker-098 v3 passes its own declared battery but still clears 14/34 genuine assertions, including three HIGH-confidence v3 discriminators (adopted quotation, rather-than merge, negated split verb), three cue-stripped twins on frozen corpus v2, and one cue-free plain positive.

next_falsifier: A successor detector that (a) clears 0 cue-induced FN on corpora v1/v2/v3 at unchanged hashes, (b) clears no cue-stripped twin and no cue-free plain positive, (c) keeps worker-07 at 17/0/10/0, (d) passes worker-098's 12 FIRE / 8 CLEAN / 5 GROWTH declared controls, and (e) reports a justified declaration diff vs c266 falsifies this audit's FAIL verdicts and the standing a8c04fc3 blocker. Specifically it must not suppress adopted quotations (A07), 'rather than' + explicit merge (A09), or negated split verbs (A12).
